name: Yamato-Security/hayabusa
description: Hayabusa is a sigma-based threat hunting and fast forensics timeline generator for Windows event logs written in memory-safe Rust with multi-threading. It processes Windows event data into consolidated timelines supporting over 4,000 Sigma rules for incident response.
score_rationale: Highly regarded Windows forensics tool with 3.1k stars, actively maintained with strong integration with Sigma detection rules.
